programs.title: The Killer Among Us
programs.desc: With just over one hundred residents, the farming village of Colon, Nebraska is built on trust; when county treasurer Sharron Erickson is found murdered in her town garage, Main Street becomes a crime scene where no one can trust their neighbor.

programs.title: Snapped
programs.desc: In the 1970s, Ted Bundy murders at least 36 young women; glamorized as a handsome, well-educated killer who outsmarted the law, Bundy may have been an evil genius or a con artist posing as privileged to hide the monster in plain sight.

programs.title: Love, Ted Bundy
programs.desc: As notorious serial killer Ted Bundy awaited execution, he exchanged chilling letters with the woman he loved like a sister; now she finally reveals the untold story of the letters, and her harrowing journey with the man she discovered was a monster.

programs.title: Dateline
programs.desc: When Kathleen Schroll makes a phone call that names her killer right before her death, it leads to the arrest of a father for murder, but after two trials and 12 years, authorities begin to wonder if he was the victim.
